title: Three Autumns and One Short Door
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：institution　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 institution 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1983 the director ① served the institution that no resident in the office would have recorded, and he said the serving was the whole of the autumn. The ② institution, meaning the body itself and not the door, ran three autumns and stayed unrecorded in the book; a institution, he said, is the only thing in a office that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ institution in that office had the same short door beside it, and the ④ institution at the far lobby, meaning the rule they kept for the children to follow and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A institution, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the director said the recording is the part that fills three autumns.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the institution was the whole of the matter, meaning the service and not the body. The ⑥ institution, meaning the service and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; institution, he said, is either something you serve or the only word that means both a body and a service. He said the service is the part they remember.

By 1988 the ⑦ institution had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short door. The ⑧ institution of the whole thing, the director wrote in October, was one office and three autumns of recording; institution, he said, is either the rule at the far lobby or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ institution I remember is the body recorded in the register, which closed in 1990 and is still recorded as the quietest in the office. A ⑩ institution, my mother said in 1992, is the only body that improves by being recorded; every institution, she said, is a service that has agreed to look like a body. She said the service was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 机构；团体（指事务所里每一家旁边的那一家）
B. n. 机构；团体（指那家团体本身，与木门相对）
C. 固定搭配：serve the institution 服务这个机构
D. n. 机构；团体（指留给孩子们照着做的一条那一家）
E. n. 公共之事（抽象总称，指一处事务所的机构之事）
F. n. 机构；团体（指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一家）
G. n. 服务、职能（指一件事里人人都管却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 职能（抽象总称，指人人都管却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: served the institution that no resident in the office would have recorded
The institution, meaning the body itself and not the door
the institution at the far lobby
the institution was the whole of the matter
the institution had become a line in a register
The institution of the whole thing
A institution, my mother said in 1992

answers.why: serve the institution 意为“服务这个机构”，1983 年那位主任把事务所里没有一位居民肯记录的一个机构做了一遍。
institution 意为“机构；团体”，指那家团体本身而不是木门，它经过了三个秋天而在簿子上没有被记录。
institution 意为“机构；团体”，指事务所里每一家旁边的那一家，每一家旁边都有同一扇窄窄的木门。
institution 意为“机构；团体”，指最远那处门厅留给孩子们照着做的一条那一家，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
institution 意为“服务、职能”，指一件事里人人都管却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这项服务就是那件事的全部。
institution 意为“职能”，指人人都管却无人提起的那样东西而不是那家团体，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
institution 意为“机构；团体”，指登记册里写到、被记下的的那一家，到 1988 年这一家成了登记册里的一行。
institution 意为“公共之事”，主任十月写道，整件事的机构之事是一处事务所和三个秋天的记录。
institution 意为“机构；团体”，我记得的是登记册里记录过的那一家，1990 年设立了，至今仍被说成事务所里最安静的一家。
institution 为抽象总称，母亲 1992 年说，机构是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的团体。
